newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lowest offer in Sri Lanka diesel tender from Vitol.
newsitem.headline: Lowest offer in Sri Lanka diesel tender from Vitol.

text.p: The lowest offer in Sri Lankan state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) import tender for diesel and jet fuel was made by Dutch trader Vitol for June 10-11 delivery, a CPC source said on Thursday.

Vitol offer for 220,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel was at a premium of five cents per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 10-cent-per-barrel premium, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo.
The tender, which closed on May 28, received six offers, the source said.

In its last tender, CPC bought from Vitol 250,000 barrels of diesel at a 14-cent-per-barrel discount to Singapore spot quotes and 50,000 barrels of jet fuel at a five-cent discount, for June 1-2 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
Sri Lanka has also issued another tender to buy 220,000 barrels of diesel and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel for June 21-22 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
The tender closes on June 4 and will be valid for two days.
The additional volume for June was needed due to the unscheduled shutdown of the country's 55,000-barrel-per-day refinery for 10-14 days starting from June 1.
